BrainFlow Android Example

Power on one Muse, select its model, and connect. The proof is complete only when BrainFlow receives EEG samples. Live X/Y/Z acceleration comes from the Muse IMU, while edge-safe brainwave powerbands appear after sixteen seconds. The optional device name must exactly match the BLE name, such as MuseS-XXXX.

Brainwave Powerbands

Delta 2–4 Hz, theta 4–8 Hz, alpha 8–13 Hz, beta 13–30 Hz, and gamma 30–45 Hz. Zero-phase filters use sixteen seconds of real data; both three-second edge guards are discarded before the central ten-second PSD.
